board.name: Virginia Board of Medicine (Department of Health Professions)

ce.reason: Renewal verifies compliance with NCCPA CME standards, and a PA whose NCCPA certification lapses is not considered licensed.

agreement.text: A PA practices on a patient care team under a written or electronic practice agreement, kept by the PA, given to the Board on request and revised whenever it changes. PAs employed by a hospital, state facility or FQHC may practice under the facility's credentialing and privileging instead.

unverified: Whether the 2026 law allowing PAs to practice without a practice agreement has taken effect

board.name: Virginia Board of Nursing and Committee of the Joint Boards of Nursing and Medicine (Department of Health Professions)

options.text: Hold an active Virginia nurse practitioner license: meet the NP renewal requirements instead
30 contact hours of workshops, seminars, conferences or courses relevant to nursing practice
15 contact hours plus 640 hours of active practice as a nurse
Current specialty certification by a national certifying organization
At least three credit hours of post-licensure academic education relevant to nursing practice
A board-approved refresher course in nursing
A nursing-related evidence-based practice project or research study, or a publication as author or co-author
Teaching or developing a nursing course of at least three semester hours of college credit, or nursing continuing education courses (up to 30 contact hours)

exemption.field: First Virginia RN renewal after initial licensure
exemption.question: Is this the first renewal after your initial Virginia licensure by examination or endorsement?
exemption.text: No continued competency activity is due at the first renewal after initial licensure by examination or endorsement.

ce.reason: Renewal requires current professional certification in the specialty; no APRN hour total is set.

cycleYears.reason: Biennially, with the Virginia RN license.

notes.text: NPs licensed before May 8, 2002 may instead complete 40 hours of CE in their specialty.

agreement.text: Until authorized for autonomous practice an NP practices under a written or electronic practice agreement with a patient care team physician, revised whenever it changes. After the equivalent of three years of full time clinical experience (1,800 hours a year) the NP may qualify for autonomous practice by fee and attestation.
